accepted_readthrough: The scalar certificate error is numerical L1 radius plus finite-L beta3 plus excluded-angular D3 radius, each counted once.
Certificate validation reconstructs the entire saved increment sum by exact Fraction interval endpoints.
The forward carry binds exact predecessor serialization by SHA and requires the consumed enclosing P_left to contain it.
Initial completed resume returns before campaign lock, output creation, or numerical callback.
Actual new panel assembly and final sum restore balls under the fixed request precision.
Failed goal is distinct from incomplete execution; a complete but insufficient enclosure gets CERTIFIED_GOAL_NOT_MET.

findings.observed: The numerical engine fingerprint omitted phys69_angular_tail.py although its MODE_SLOPE and SCREEN_ELLIPSE_M feed the new D3 angular bound.
findings.requested_fix: Add this numerical dependency to the current engine fingerprint before starting a real campaign.

findings.observed: The resumed certificate checked the scalar error fields but did not verify the advertised D3_full_radial_all_angular_box or duplicated physical source/coefficient/scope fields.
findings.requested_fix: Require exact coordinate containment of the finite-cutoff box plus the analytic radial/angular error square and verify source, coefficient and claimed scope/count bindings.

findings.observed: On timeout, SIGKILL was sent to the owned group only if the direct child remained alive after SIGTERM. A descendant ignoring SIGTERM could outlive a direct child that had already exited.
findings.requested_fix: Finish owned-group cleanup after timeout regardless of the direct-child wait outcome, retaining the process receipt.

findings.observed: A clean CLI import may create Python bytecode even when the campaign function makes no writes.
findings.requested_fix: Disable bytecode writes in the CLI and child invocation or bind the read-only receipt explicitly to campaign output only.

findings.observed: The second inspection after acquiring the lock did not recheck exists with resume=False. An output created after the first inspection could be implicitly resumed.
findings.requested_fix: Repeat the existing-output/no-resume gate under the lock before appending.

receipt_scope: This is the preserved first read-only review. Later corrections and validation belong to a separate final readback; do not relabel this file as a final PASS.
